label: Simple
description: Just the essentials. Solid surfaces, static focus, and no glass or background blur. The lightest visual workload.

label: Light
description: A little movement, a lot of simplicity. Gentle card motion with solid surfaces. Glass and background blur stay off.

label: Balanced
description: Soft card movement. Lighter glass. A little background blur. A good place to start.

label: Rich
description: A more expressive home. Full card movement and reflections, stronger glass, and more background blur.

label: Full effect
description: The strongest glass and background blur on the usual rendering path. Prepared effects are reused where supported.

label: Live Liquid Glass
description: The richest live glass, with card animation even while holding an arrow key. The highest graphics workload; scrolling may be less smooth on your TV.
